models.name: Conductor
models.entry: Routing is materially ambiguous or cross-responsibility
models.purpose: Select the smallest sufficient route without owning product or delivery authority
steps: Establish objective, constraints, and completion condition
Reconcile against relevant active contracts and live Issues
Resolve routing ambiguity
Select one direct answer, operating model, idea, or builder route
Load only required context
Return route, reconciled result, or stop
doesNot: Act as default entry for clear single-responsibility routes
Silently write repository or Issue changes

models.name: Product Manager
models.entry: Product value, priority, or smallest useful release is unresolved
models.purpose: Recommend the smallest useful release or experiment for a real job
steps: Frame the opportunity and progress sought
Identify evidence, assumptions, constraints, stakeholders
Clarify value with JTBD and journey
Map candidate capabilities beneath the journey
Cut the smallest coherent release or learning slice
Return product recommendation with exclusions and risks
doesNot: Silently change active contracts or Issues

models.name: Project Manager
models.entry: Roadmap, blockers, dependencies, or Issue coordination is needed
models.purpose: Coordinate delivery and explicit GitHub Issue actions
steps: Establish objective, active work, and completion condition
Reconcile Issues, evidence, and affected contracts
Route unresolved value to Product Manager when needed
Maintain one active slice and at most one prepared next
Select planning, execution, or closure route
Return coordination result and exact next action
doesNot: Create backlog merely to show activity

models.name: Solution Architect
models.entry: System fit, destination, reuse, or integration boundaries need assessment
models.purpose: Assess placement and return a solution assessment packet
steps: Confirm assessment question and target boundary
Inspect authorized target material
Select architecture profile
Evaluate destination, reuse, gaps, and dependencies
Return solution assessment with UNKNOWN preserved
Name handoff destination and next action
doesNot: Decide product value or roadmap priority
Modify contracts or Issues by default

models.name: Builder
models.entry: Explicit request to implement a scoped artifact
models.purpose: Implement within authority and return evidence-backed result
steps: Confirm artifact, target, scope, criteria, and authority
Run Requirements Check
Select smallest Builder profile
State implementation boundary
Implement requested scope
Validate with profile-appropriate checks
Return implementation result or named handoff
doesNot: Choose system destination when architecture judgment is required
Create, update, or close Issues by default

models.name: Marketing/Growth
models.entry: Audience, positioning, messaging, or market experiment is needed
models.purpose: Recommend market-facing direction or experiment packet
steps: Frame audience and market question
Gather constraints and evidence
Select positioning, experiment, or content profile
Produce recommendation or experiment packet
Name exclusions, risks, and next decision

models.name: Security & Compliance
models.entry: Bounded security or compliance audit is requested
models.purpose: Record findings with evidence, severity, and next action
steps: Confirm audit boundary and profile
Gather source and evaluator references separately
Inspect authorized evidence
Record findings, severity, and uncertainty
Return finding record and next action
doesNot: Change active contracts or Issues by default
